kritarchy_events.1.desc.en: The supreme court has finished debating on which judge should be elected as the new [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle]. The cabinet is excited to celebrate [successor_character.GetName] as the new leader of [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName].
kritarchy_events.1.desc.uk: Верховний суд завершив нараду, і [Select_CString(ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.IsFemale,'нова', 'новий')] [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle|l] нарешті [Select_CString(ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetRuler.IsFemale,'обрана', 'обраний')] — це [successor_character.GetName]. Рада з радістю вшановує нового лідера #ONCLICK:COUNTRY,[ROOT.GetCountry.Custom('CL_tt')] #TOOLTIP:COUNTRY,[ROOT.GetCountry.Custom('CL_tt')],X [ROOT.GetCountry.Custom('CL_GEN')|L]#!#!.
